best_under_budget:
MATCH (t:Test)<-[:VERSION_OF]-(tv:TestVersion)<-[:USED]-(mt:Match)-[:PART_OF]->(r:Run),
      (mt)<-[:IN]-(a:Attempt)-[:BY]->(m:Model)
WHERE NOT mt.excluded
  AND ($test_id IS NULL OR t.id = $test_id)
  AND ($suite IS NULL OR r.suite = $suite)
  AND ($version_key IS NULL OR tv.key = $version_key)
  AND (NOT $current_only OR NOT EXISTS {
        MATCH (tv)-[:VERSION_OF]->(:Test)<-[:VERSION_OF]-(newer:TestVersion) WHERE newer.version_rank > tv.version_rank })
OPTIONAL MATCH (mt)-[:WON_BY]->(w:Model)
WITH m.name AS model, a, mt, tv,
     CASE WHEN w.name = m.name THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS won,
     CASE WHEN w IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS tied,
     CASE WHEN a.passed THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS ok
WITH model, count(a) AS attempts, sum(won) AS pair_wins, sum(tied) AS ties, sum(ok) AS passed,
     sum(a.cost_usd) AS spent, avg(a.cost_usd) AS cost_per_attempt, avg(a.mistakes) AS mistakes,
     avg(a.progress) AS progress, collect(DISTINCT mt.run_id) AS runs, collect(DISTINCT tv.key) AS versions
RETURN model, attempts, pair_wins, ties, passed, cost_per_attempt, versions,
       CASE WHEN passed = 0 THEN NULL ELSE spent / passed END AS cost_per_clean,
       mistakes, progress, cost_per_attempt <= $budget AS within_budget, runs,
       toFloat(pair_wins) / attempts AS win_rate
ORDER BY within_budget DESC, win_rate DESC, cost_per_attempt
head_to_head:
MATCH (t:Test)<-[:VERSION_OF]-(tv:TestVersion)<-[:USED]-(mt:Match)-[:PART_OF]->(r:Run)
WHERE NOT mt.excluded
  AND ($test_id IS NULL OR t.id = $test_id)
  AND ($suite IS NULL OR r.suite = $suite)
  AND ($version_key IS NULL OR tv.key = $version_key)
  AND (NOT $current_only OR NOT EXISTS {
        MATCH (tv)-[:VERSION_OF]->(:Test)<-[:VERSION_OF]-(newer:TestVersion) WHERE newer.version_rank > tv.version_rank })
MATCH (mt)<-[:IN]-(:Attempt)-[:BY]->(x:Model {name: $a}), (mt)<-[:IN]-(:Attempt)-[:BY]->(y:Model {name: $b})
OPTIONAL MATCH (mt)-[:WON_BY]->(w:Model)
RETURN mt.key AS match, tv.version AS version, mt.difficulty AS difficulty, mt.rule AS rule,
       coalesce(w.name, 'tie') AS winner
ORDER BY mt.key
hazard_profile:
MATCH (a:Attempt)-[:BY]->(m:Model), (a)-[:IN]->(mt:Match)-[:USED]->(:TestVersion)-[:INCLUDES]->(h:Hazard)
WHERE NOT mt.excluded
OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[t:TRIPPED_ON]->(h)
WITH m.name AS model, h.name AS hazard, count(a) AS exposed, count(t) AS tripped, sum(coalesce(t.count, 0)) AS times
RETURN model, hazard, exposed, tripped, times, toFloat(tripped) / exposed AS rate
ORDER BY hazard, rate DESC, model
beat_cycles:
MATCH (tv:TestVersion)<-[:USED]-(mt:Match)-[:PART_OF]->(r:Run), (mt)<-[:IN]-(:Attempt)-[:BY]->(m:Model)
WHERE NOT mt.excluded AND ($suite IS NULL OR r.suite = $suite)
WITH tv, mt, collect(m) AS p
OPTIONAL MATCH (mt)-[:WON_BY]->(w:Model)
WITH tv, p[0] AS x, p[1] AS y,
     sum(CASE WHEN w = p[0] THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS xw, sum(CASE WHEN w = p[1] THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS yw
WHERE xw <> yw
WITH tv, CASE WHEN xw > yw THEN [x.name, y.name, xw, yw] ELSE [y.name, x.name, yw, xw] END AS beat
WITH tv, collect(beat) AS beats
UNWIND beats AS ab
UNWIND beats AS bc
UNWIND beats AS ca
WITH tv, ab, bc, ca
WHERE ab[1] = bc[0] AND bc[1] = ca[0] AND ca[1] = ab[0] AND ab[0] < bc[0] AND ab[0] < ca[0]
RETURN tv.key AS version, ab[0] AS a, bc[0] AS b, ca[0] AS c,
       [toString(ab[2]) + '-' + toString(ab[3]), toString(bc[2]) + '-' + toString(bc[3]),
        toString(ca[2]) + '-' + toString(ca[3])] AS margins,
       [ab[2] - ab[3], bc[2] - bc[3], ca[2] - ca[3]] AS leads
ORDER BY version
beats:
MATCH (tv:TestVersion)<-[:USED]-(mt:Match)<-[:IN]-(:Attempt)-[:BY]->(m:Model)
WHERE NOT mt.excluded
WITH tv, mt, collect(m.name) AS p
OPTIONAL MATCH (mt)-[:WON_BY]->(w:Model)
WITH tv, p[0] AS x, p[1] AS y,
     sum(CASE WHEN w.name = p[0] THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS x_wins,
     sum(CASE WHEN w.name = p[1] THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS y_wins,
     count(*) AS pairs
RETURN tv.key AS version, x AS a, y AS b, x_wins AS a_wins, y_wins AS b_wins, pairs
ORDER BY version, a, b
promotion:
MATCH (tv:TestVersion)
OPTIONAL MATCH (tv)-[:VALIDATED_BY]->(v:ValidationRun)
WITH tv, count(v) AS checks, sum(CASE WHEN v.ok THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS failed_checks
OPTIONAL MATCH (tv)<-[:USED]-(mt:Match)<-[:IN]-(:Attempt)-[:BY]->(m:Model)
WHERE NOT mt.excluded
WITH tv, checks, failed_checks, count(DISTINCT m) AS models, collect(DISTINCT mt) AS matches
WITH tv, checks, failed_checks, models, size(matches) AS pairs,
     size([x IN matches WHERE x.rule <> 'tie']) AS decisive
RETURN tv.key AS version, tv.test_id AS test, tv.status AS status_at_run,
       checks > 0 AND failed_checks = 0 AS validated, checks, failed_checks, models, pairs, decisive,
       CASE WHEN pairs = 0 THEN NULL ELSE toFloat(decisive) / pairs END AS decisive_share
ORDER BY validated DESC, models DESC, pairs DESC
stale_results:
MATCH (old:TestVersion)<-[:USED]-(mt:Match)
OPTIONAL MATCH (old)-[:VERSION_OF]->(:Test)<-[:VERSION_OF]-(newer:TestVersion)
WHERE newer.version_rank > old.version_rank
OPTIONAL MATCH (fork:TestVersion)-[:FORKED_FROM]->(old)
WITH old, count(DISTINCT mt) AS matches, collect(DISTINCT newer.version) AS newer_versions,
     collect(DISTINCT fork.key) AS forks
WHERE size(newer_versions) > 0 OR size(forks) > 0
RETURN old.key AS version, matches, newer_versions, forks
ORDER BY version
sources:
MATCH (s:Source)
OPTIONAL MATCH (r:Run)-[:FROM]->(s)
WITH s, count(r) AS runs
OPTIONAL MATCH (v:ValidationRun)-[:FROM]->(s)
WITH s, runs, count(v) AS validation_checks
OPTIONAL MATCH (b:Benchmark)-[:FROM]->(s)
OPTIONAL MATCH (:Model)-[sc:SCORED]->(b)
RETURN s.name AS source, s.description AS description, runs, validation_checks, count(sc) AS published_scores
ORDER BY source
close_to:
MATCH (me:Model {name: $model})-[mine:SCORED]->(b:Benchmark {name: $benchmark})<-[theirs:SCORED]-(other:Model)
WHERE other <> me AND (NOT $open_only OR other.weights = 'open')
OPTIONAL MATCH (me)<-[:BY]-(:Attempt)-[:IN]->(mt:Match)<-[:IN]-(:Attempt)-[:BY]->(other)
WHERE NOT mt.excluded
WITH mine, theirs, other, count(DISTINCT mt) AS pairs_played
OPTIONAL MATCH (other)<-[:BY]-(x:Attempt)
WITH mine, theirs, other, pairs_played, count(x) AS attempts
RETURN other.name AS model, other.display_name AS display_name, other.weights AS weights,
       theirs.score AS score, theirs.score - mine.score AS gap,
       (theirs.low <= mine.high AND mine.low <= theirs.high) AS ranges_overlap,
       attempts > 0 AS has_matches, pairs_played
ORDER BY abs(theirs.score - mine.score), model
LIMIT 25
find_flow:
MATCH (tv:TestVersion)
SEARCH tv IN (FULLTEXT INDEX flow_text FOR $q LIMIT 20) SCORE AS score
MATCH (tv)-[:VERSION_OF]->(t:Test)
WHERE NOT EXISTS { MATCH (t)<-[:VERSION_OF]-(newer:TestVersion) WHERE newer.version_rank > tv.version_rank }
OPTIONAL MATCH (tv)<-[:USED]-(mt:Match)<-[:IN]-(:Attempt)-[:BY]->(m:Model)
WHERE NOT mt.excluded
RETURN t.id AS test, tv.title AS title, tv.version AS version, score, tv.brief AS brief, tv.emulates AS emulates,
       tv.tools AS tools, count(DISTINCT m) AS models, count(DISTINCT mt) AS pairs
ORDER BY score DESC
flows:
MATCH (t:Test)<-[:VERSION_OF]-(tv:TestVersion)<-[:USED]-(mt:Match)<-[:IN]-(:Attempt)-[:BY]->(m:Model)
WHERE NOT mt.excluded
  AND NOT EXISTS { MATCH (t)<-[:VERSION_OF]-(newer:TestVersion) WHERE newer.version_rank > tv.version_rank }
RETURN t.id AS test, tv.title AS title, tv.version AS version, tv.brief AS brief, tv.emulates AS emulates,
       tv.tools AS tools, count(DISTINCT m) AS models, count(DISTINCT mt) AS pairs
ORDER BY test
flow_as_tested:
MATCH (t:Test {id: $test_id})<-[:VERSION_OF]-(tv:TestVersion {key: $version_key})
OPTIONAL MATCH (tv)<-[:USED]-(mt:Match)-[:PART_OF]->(r:Run)
WHERE r.run_id IN $runs
RETURN tv.key AS version, tv.title AS title, tv.brief AS brief, tv.policy AS policy, tv.tools AS tools,
       tv.emulates AS emulates, tv.tags AS tags, tv.content_sha256 AS content_sha256, tv.action_budget AS action_budget,
       collect(DISTINCT mt.difficulty) AS difficulty, collect(DISTINCT r.effort) AS effort,
       collect(DISTINCT r.max_output_tokens) AS max_output_tokens,
       collect(DISTINCT r.attempt_budget_usd) AS attempt_budget_usd, collect(DISTINCT r.suite) AS suites
pair_on_task:
MATCH (t:Test {id: $test_id})<-[:VERSION_OF]-(tv:TestVersion)<-[:USED]-(mt:Match)-[:PART_OF]->(r:Run),
      (mt)<-[:IN]-(xa:Attempt)-[:BY]->(:Model {name: $a}),
      (mt)<-[:IN]-(xb:Attempt)-[:BY]->(:Model {name: $b})
WHERE NOT mt.excluded
  AND ($suite IS NULL OR r.suite = $suite)
  AND ($version_key IS NULL OR tv.key = $version_key)
  AND ($until IS NULL OR r.started_unix <= $until)
  AND ($conditions IS NULL OR mt.conditions = $conditions)
OPTIONAL MATCH (mt)-[:WON_BY]->(w:Model)
RETURN mt.key AS match, r.run_id AS run, r.seal_sha256 AS seal, r.engine_commit AS engine, r.suite AS suite,
       coalesce(r.answer_key, false) AS answer_key,
       tv.key AS version, mt.difficulty AS difficulty, mt.rule AS rule, coalesce(w.name, 'tie') AS winner,
       xa.passed AS a_passed, coalesce(xa.task_correct, xa.passed) AS a_right,
       xb.passed AS b_passed, coalesce(xb.task_correct, xb.passed) AS b_right,
       xa.cost_usd AS a_cost, xa.wall_s AS a_time, xa.mistakes AS a_mistakes,
       xa.effort AS a_effort, xa.cost_basis AS a_basis, xa.calls AS a_calls,
       xa.tokens_in AS a_in, xa.tokens_cached AS a_cached, xa.tokens_out AS a_out,
       xb.cost_usd AS b_cost, xb.wall_s AS b_time, xb.mistakes AS b_mistakes,
       xb.effort AS b_effort, xb.cost_basis AS b_basis, xb.calls AS b_calls,
       xb.tokens_in AS b_in, xb.tokens_cached AS b_cached, xb.tokens_out AS b_out
ORDER BY mt.key
pair_conditions:
MATCH (t:Test {id: $test_id})<-[:VERSION_OF]-(tv:TestVersion)<-[:USED]-(mt:Match)-[:PART_OF]->(r:Run),
      (mt)<-[:IN]-(:Attempt)-[:BY]->(:Model {name: $a}),
      (mt)<-[:IN]-(:Attempt)-[:BY]->(:Model {name: $b})
WHERE NOT mt.excluded
  AND ($suite IS NULL OR r.suite = $suite)
  AND ($version_key IS NULL OR tv.key = $version_key)
  AND ($until IS NULL OR r.started_unix <= $until)
RETURN mt.conditions AS conditions, count(mt) AS pairs,
       sum(CASE WHEN coalesce(r.suite, '') STARTS WITH 'live-' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS suite_pairs
ORDER BY conditions
task_conditions:
MATCH (t:Test {id: $test_id})<-[:VERSION_OF]-(tv:TestVersion)<-[:USED]-(mt:Match)-[:PART_OF]->(r:Run)
WHERE NOT mt.excluded AND NOT coalesce(r.suite, '') STARTS WITH 'live-'
  AND ($suite IS NULL OR r.suite = $suite)
  AND ($version_key IS NULL OR tv.key = $version_key)
  AND ($until IS NULL OR r.started_unix <= $until)
RETURN mt.conditions AS conditions, count(mt) AS pairs
ORDER BY conditions
pair_hazards:
MATCH (t:Test {id: $test_id})<-[:VERSION_OF]-(tv:TestVersion)<-[:USED]-(mt:Match)-[:PART_OF]->(r:Run),
      (mt)<-[:IN]-(x:Attempt)-[:BY]->(m:Model), (mt)<-[:IN]-(:Attempt)-[:BY]->(o:Model)
WHERE NOT mt.excluded AND m.name IN [$a, $b] AND o.name IN [$a, $b] AND m.name <> o.name
  AND ($suite IS NULL OR r.suite = $suite)
  AND ($version_key IS NULL OR tv.key = $version_key)
  AND ($until IS NULL OR r.started_unix <= $until)
  AND ($conditions IS NULL OR mt.conditions = $conditions)
MATCH (tv)-[:INCLUDES]->(h:Hazard)
OPTIONAL MATCH (x)-[tr:TRIPPED_ON]->(h)
WITH m.name AS model, h.name AS hazard, count(x) AS exposed, count(tr) AS tripped
RETURN model, hazard, exposed, tripped
ORDER BY hazard, model
what_went_wrong:
MATCH (r:Run)<-[:PART_OF]-(mt:Match)<-[:IN]-(x:Attempt)-[:BY]->(m:Model)
WHERE NOT x.passed AND NOT mt.excluded
  AND ($run IS NULL OR r.run_id = $run) AND ($matches IS NULL OR mt.key IN $matches)
OPTIONAL MATCH (x)-[made:MADE]->(f:Fault)
RETURN mt.key AS match, x.side AS side, m.name AS model, coalesce(x.task_correct, x.passed) AS right,
       x.termination AS ended, x.items AS items, f.name AS fault, f.kind AS kind, made.count AS count
ORDER BY match, side, kind, fault
what_went_wrong_self:
MATCH (r:Run)<-[:PART_OF]-(sc:SelfCheck)<-[:IN]-(x:SelfAttempt)-[:BY]->(m:Model)
WHERE NOT x.passed AND NOT sc.excluded AND ($run IS NULL OR r.run_id = $run)
OPTIONAL MATCH (x)-[made:MADE]->(f:Fault)
RETURN sc.key AS match, x.side AS side, m.name AS model, coalesce(x.task_correct, x.passed) AS right,
       x.termination AS ended, x.items AS items, f.name AS fault, f.kind AS kind, made.count AS count
ORDER BY match, side, kind, fault
fault_profile:
MATCH (t:Test {id: $test_id})<-[:VERSION_OF]-(tv:TestVersion)-[:CAN_SHOW]->(f:Fault),
      (tv)<-[:USED]-(mt:Match)<-[:IN]-(a:Attempt)-[:BY]->(m:Model)
WHERE NOT mt.excluded AND ($version_key IS NULL OR tv.key = $version_key)
OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[x:MADE]->(f)
OPTIONAL MATCH (f)-[:KIND_OF]->(parent:Fault)
WITH m.name AS model, f.name AS fault, f.kind AS kind, parent.name AS kind_of,
     count(a) AS attempts, count(x) AS attempts_with, sum(coalesce(x.count, 0)) AS times
RETURN model, fault, kind, kind_of, attempts, attempts_with, times, toFloat(attempts_with) / attempts AS rate
ORDER BY model, kind, times DESC, fault
task_attempts:
MATCH (tv:TestVersion {key: $version_key})<-[:USED]-(mt:Match)-[:PART_OF]->(r:Run),
      (mt)<-[:IN]-(a:Attempt)-[:BY]->(m:Model)
WHERE NOT mt.excluded AND ($conditions IS NULL OR mt.conditions = $conditions) AND ($suite IS NULL OR r.suite = $suite)
  AND ($until IS NULL OR r.started_unix <= $until)
RETURN m.name AS model, m.display_name AS display_name, count(a) AS attempts,
       sum(CASE WHEN a.passed THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS passed,
       sum(CASE WHEN coalesce(a.task_correct, a.passed) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS right,
       avg(a.cost_usd) AS cost_per_attempt
ORDER BY cost_per_attempt, model
self_attempts:
MATCH (tv:TestVersion {key: $version_key})<-[:USED]-(sc:SelfCheck)-[:PART_OF]->(r:Run),
      (sc)<-[:IN]-(a:SelfAttempt)-[:BY]->(m:Model)
WHERE NOT sc.excluded AND ($conditions IS NULL OR sc.conditions = $conditions) AND ($suite IS NULL OR r.suite = $suite)
  AND ($until IS NULL OR r.started_unix <= $until)
RETURN m.name AS model, m.display_name AS display_name, count(a) AS attempts,
       sum(CASE WHEN a.passed THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS passed,
       sum(CASE WHEN coalesce(a.task_correct, a.passed) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS right, sum(a.cost_usd) AS spent
ORDER BY model
self_faults:
MATCH (tv:TestVersion {key: $version_key})-[:CAN_SHOW]->(f:Fault),
      (tv)<-[:USED]-(sc:SelfCheck)-[:PART_OF]->(r:Run), (sc)<-[:IN]-(a:SelfAttempt)-[:BY]->(m:Model)
WHERE NOT sc.excluded AND ($conditions IS NULL OR sc.conditions = $conditions) AND ($suite IS NULL OR r.suite = $suite)
  AND ($until IS NULL OR r.started_unix <= $until)
OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[x:MADE]->(f)
OPTIONAL MATCH (f)-[:KIND_OF]->(parent:Fault)
WITH m.name AS model, f.name AS fault, f.kind AS kind, parent.name AS kind_of,
     count(x) AS attempts_with, sum(coalesce(x.count, 0)) AS times
RETURN model, fault, kind, kind_of, attempts_with, times
ORDER BY model, fault
self_consistency:
MATCH (tv:TestVersion {key: $version_key})<-[:USED]-(sc:SelfCheck)-[:BY]->(m:Model), (sc)-[:PART_OF]->(r:Run)
WHERE NOT sc.excluded AND m.name IN $models
  AND ($conditions IS NULL OR sc.conditions = $conditions) AND ($suite IS NULL OR r.suite = $suite)
  AND ($until IS NULL OR r.started_unix <= $until)
OPTIONAL MATCH (sc)<-[:IN]-(a:SelfAttempt)
WITH m.name AS model, sc, sum(CASE WHEN a.passed THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ok
RETURN model, count(sc) AS scenarios, sum(CASE WHEN sc.same THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS same,
       2 * count(sc) AS attempts, sum(ok) AS passed
ORDER BY model
task_faults:
MATCH (tv:TestVersion {key: $version_key})-[:CAN_SHOW]->(f:Fault),
      (tv)<-[:USED]-(mt:Match)-[:PART_OF]->(r:Run), (mt)<-[:IN]-(a:Attempt)-[:BY]->(m:Model)
WHERE NOT mt.excluded AND ($conditions IS NULL OR mt.conditions = $conditions) AND ($suite IS NULL OR r.suite = $suite)
  AND ($until IS NULL OR r.started_unix <= $until)
OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[x:MADE]->(f)
OPTIONAL MATCH (f)-[:KIND_OF]->(parent:Fault)
WITH m.name AS model, f.name AS fault, f.kind AS kind, parent.name AS kind_of,
     count(x) AS attempts_with, sum(coalesce(x.count, 0)) AS times
RETURN model, fault, kind, kind_of, attempts_with, times
ORDER BY model, fault
what_decisions_need:
MATCH (tv:TestVersion {key: $version_key})<-[:USED]-(mt:Match)<-[:IN]-(t:Item)
WHERE EXISTS { (t)<-[:DECIDED]-(:Step) }
MATCH p = (t)-[:REFERS_TO*1..3]->(need:Item)
RETURN t.kind AS decided, [x IN relationships(p) | x.field] AS via, need.kind AS needs, count(*) AS times
ORDER BY size(via), needs
same_world:
MATCH (mt:Match)<-[:IN]-(t:Item)
WHERE mt.key IN $matches AND EXISTS { (t)<-[:DECIDED]-(:Step) }
MATCH (mt)<-[:IN]-(a:Attempt)-[:BY]->(m:Model)
OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[:TOOK]->(act:Step {kind: 'act'})-[:DECIDED]->(t)
WITH mt, t, a, m, act ORDER BY act.n
WITH mt, t, a, m, last(collect(act)) AS act
OPTIONAL MATCH (t)-[:REFERS_TO*1..3]->(need:Item)
WITH mt, t, a, m, act, need,
     CASE WHEN act IS NULL THEN NULL
          ELSE EXISTS { MATCH (need)<-[:SAW]-(s:Step)<-[:TOOK]-(a) WHERE s.n < act.n } END AS seen
ORDER BY need.kind, need.id
WITH mt, t, a, m, act,
     collect(CASE WHEN need IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE {record: need.id, kind: need.kind, seen: seen} END) AS needs
RETURN mt.key AS match, t.id AS item, t.kind AS kind, m.name AS model, a.side AS side, act.tool AS decision,
       act.n AS step, act.at_s AS at_s, act.state AS state, needs
ORDER BY match, item, side
world_records:
MATCH (mt:Match)<-[:IN]-(x:Item)
WHERE mt.key IN $matches
OPTIONAL MATCH (x)-[r:REFERS_TO]->(y:Item)
WITH mt, x, y, r ORDER BY y.id
RETURN mt.key AS match, x.id AS id, x.kind AS kind,
       collect(CASE WHEN y IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE {to: y.id, field: r.field} END) AS refers
ORDER BY match, id
world_seen:
MATCH (mt:Match)<-[:IN]-(a:Attempt)-[:TOOK]->(s:Step)-[:SAW]->(i:Item)
WHERE mt.key IN $matches
RETURN mt.key AS match, a.side AS side, i.id AS record, min(s.n) AS step, min(s.at_s) AS at_s
ORDER BY match, side, record
steps:decided-before-seeing:
MATCH (tv:TestVersion {key: $version_key})<-[:USED]-(mt:Match)-[:PART_OF]->(r:Run),
      (mt)<-[:IN]-(a:Attempt)-[:BY]->(m:Model)
WHERE NOT mt.excluded AND ($conditions IS NULL OR mt.conditions = $conditions) AND ($suite IS NULL OR r.suite = $suite)
  AND ($until IS NULL OR r.started_unix <= $until)

OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[:TOOK]->(act:Step {kind: 'act'})-[:DECIDED]->(x:Item)-[:REFERS_TO*1..3]->(need:Item)
WHERE act.state <> 'refused' AND ($kinds IS NULL OR need.kind IN $kinds)
  AND NOT EXISTS { MATCH (need)<-[:SAW]-(seen:Step)<-[:TOOK]-(a) WHERE seen.n < act.n }
WITH m.name AS model, a, count(DISTINCT x) AS times
RETURN model, count(a) AS attempts, sum(times) AS times,
       sum(CASE WHEN times > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS attempts_with,
       sum(CASE WHEN times > 0 AND coalesce(a.task_correct, a.passed) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS right_with,
       sum(CASE WHEN times > 0 AND a.passed THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS passed_with
ORDER BY model
steps:decided-never-saw:
MATCH (tv:TestVersion {key: $version_key})<-[:USED]-(mt:Match)-[:PART_OF]->(r:Run),
      (mt)<-[:IN]-(a:Attempt)-[:BY]->(m:Model)
WHERE NOT mt.excluded AND ($conditions IS NULL OR mt.conditions = $conditions) AND ($suite IS NULL OR r.suite = $suite)
  AND ($until IS NULL OR r.started_unix <= $until)

OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[:TOOK]->(act:Step {kind: 'act'})-[:DECIDED]->(x:Item)-[:REFERS_TO*1..3]->(need:Item)
WHERE act.state <> 'refused' AND ($kinds IS NULL OR need.kind IN $kinds)
  AND NOT EXISTS { MATCH (need)<-[:SAW]-(:Step)<-[:TOOK]-(a) }
WITH m.name AS model, a, count(DISTINCT x) AS times
RETURN model, count(a) AS attempts, sum(times) AS times,
       sum(CASE WHEN times > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS attempts_with,
       sum(CASE WHEN times > 0 AND coalesce(a.task_correct, a.passed) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS right_with,
       sum(CASE WHEN times > 0 AND a.passed THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS passed_with
ORDER BY model
steps:decided-unknown-record:
MATCH (tv:TestVersion {key: $version_key})<-[:USED]-(mt:Match)-[:PART_OF]->(r:Run),
      (mt)<-[:IN]-(a:Attempt)-[:BY]->(m:Model)
WHERE NOT mt.excluded AND ($conditions IS NULL OR mt.conditions = $conditions) AND ($suite IS NULL OR r.suite = $suite)
  AND ($until IS NULL OR r.started_unix <= $until)

OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[:TOOK]->(act:Step {kind: 'act'})-[:DECIDED]->(x:Item)
WHERE act.state <> 'refused' AND NOT EXISTS { (x)<-[:SAW]-(:Step) }
WITH m.name AS model, a, count(DISTINCT x) AS times
RETURN model, count(a) AS attempts, sum(times) AS times,
       sum(CASE WHEN times > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS attempts_with,
       sum(CASE WHEN times > 0 AND coalesce(a.task_correct, a.passed) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS right_with,
       sum(CASE WHEN times > 0 AND a.passed THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS passed_with
ORDER BY model
steps:retried-without-checking:
MATCH (tv:TestVersion {key: $version_key})<-[:USED]-(mt:Match)-[:PART_OF]->(r:Run),
      (mt)<-[:IN]-(a:Attempt)-[:BY]->(m:Model)
WHERE NOT mt.excluded AND ($conditions IS NULL OR mt.conditions = $conditions) AND ($suite IS NULL OR r.suite = $suite)
  AND ($until IS NULL OR r.started_unix <= $until)

OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[:TOOK]->(first:Step {kind: 'act', state: 'timeout'})-[:DECIDED]->(t:Item)
OPTIONAL MATCH p = (first)-[:NEXT]->+(x:Step {kind: 'act'})
WHERE (x)-[:DECIDED]->(t) AND none(s IN nodes(p)[1..-1] WHERE (s)-[:CHECKED]->(t) OR (s)-[:DECIDED]->(t))
WITH m.name AS model, a, count(DISTINCT x) AS times
RETURN model, count(a) AS attempts, sum(times) AS times,
       sum(CASE WHEN times > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS attempts_with,
       sum(CASE WHEN times > 0 AND coalesce(a.task_correct, a.passed) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS right_with,
       sum(CASE WHEN times > 0 AND a.passed THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS passed_with
ORDER BY model
steps:told-then-decided:
MATCH (tv:TestVersion {key: $version_key})<-[:USED]-(mt:Match)-[:PART_OF]->(r:Run),
      (mt)<-[:IN]-(a:Attempt)-[:BY]->(m:Model)
WHERE NOT mt.excluded AND ($conditions IS NULL OR mt.conditions = $conditions) AND ($suite IS NULL OR r.suite = $suite)
  AND ($until IS NULL OR r.started_unix <= $until)

OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[:TOOK]->(told:Step)-[:TOLD_OF]->(rec:Item)<-[:REFERS_TO*1..3]-(x:Item)<-[:DECIDED]-(act:Step {kind: 'act'}),
               (act)<-[:TOOK]-(a)
WHERE act.n > told.n AND act.state <> 'refused' AND ($kinds IS NULL OR rec.kind IN $kinds)
  AND NOT EXISTS { MATCH (rec)<-[:SAW]-(again:Step)<-[:TOOK]-(a) WHERE again.n > told.n AND again.n < act.n }
WITH m.name AS model, a, count(DISTINCT x) AS times
RETURN model, count(a) AS attempts, sum(times) AS times,
       sum(CASE WHEN times > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS attempts_with,
       sum(CASE WHEN times > 0 AND coalesce(a.task_correct, a.passed) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS right_with,
       sum(CASE WHEN times > 0 AND a.passed THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS passed_with
ORDER BY model
